# Read Scripture in context — Christmas Lantern 08

The game now includes all 87 supplied CSB verses across 45 focus cards. Every card has an extended reference and an editorial context note. Its folded section includes the supplied chapter selections with verse numbers and explicit gaps. Full surrounding ranges not present in the paste open through Blue Letter Bible links and are not represented as already bundled.

Paste CSB-Extended-References-08.txt into https://www.blueletterbible.org/tools/MultiVerse.cfm and select CSB if you want to retrieve all wider ranges for offline integration later.

## Markdown fields

The existing Lantern Road metadata block now accepts optional context_reference, context_note, context_selection and context_verses (an array of verse/text pairs). source_book and source_chapter create the BLB chapter link. No core parser fork is needed; imported collections without these fields receive a generic chapter link where the reference is recognized. Treat context notes as editorial and preserve exact supplied Scripture text.
